lines.line: Summary: She runs the Rayne Syndicate and is fought with her partner Grizzbolt in the Tower in the Windswept Hills. She is the first Faction Leader you are expected to fight and the easiest of them, at level 10 in normal mode and level 72 in hard mode.

quoted: She is the leader of the Rayne Syndicate and her partner Pal is Grizzbolt, with her Tower being located in the Windswept Hills.
being the first Faction Leader the player is expected to fight.
Though Zoe is the easiest faction leader boss in the game
|| Zoe and Grizzbolt || 10 || 72

lines.line: Weak points: Grizzbolt is an Electric Pal that mostly uses Electric moves, so Ground-element Pals are the best answer. Early picks that work well are Gumoss, Rushoar and Fuddler, all easy to find. Dumud also works, but its Water side means Electric moves hit it for normal damage instead of being resisted. The Crossbow, which you can have by level 13, is usually the best weapon, and the Three Shot Bow suits Grizzbolt's large size.

quoted: As Grizzbolt is an Electric-element Pal and uses mostly Electric-element attacks, Ground-element Pals are recommended when fighting it.
Gumoss, Rushoar, and Fuddler, are all good choices and can be obtained very early on.
Dumud is also a decent choice, though it also being part Water-element means that it'll take normal damage from Grizzbolt's Electric attacks instead of resisting them.
The Crossbow is typically the best weapon option for this fight as it can be obtained pretty early on (at level 13)
the Three Shot Bow also works well due to Grizzbolt's large size.

lines.line: Looks like: Zoe's hair is in two pigtails, black on the left and pink on the right. She has a black beanie with two ear-like shapes on it and a leather jacket in black, cut short, with the sleeves marked in pink.

quoted: Her hair is tied into two pigtails, with the left being black and the right being pink
Her black beanie has two ear-like shapes
She wears a short black leather jacket with pink lines on the sleeves

lines.line: Tips: Grizzbolt's Lightning Claw is hard to dodge, so if dodging is not your strength, lean on a shield to take the hits; circling behind the pillars avoids most of its attacks. Recalling your Pal just before Grizzbolt hits it, then sending it out again, spares it the damage and makes it attack faster. In hard mode a level 55 Syndicate Crusher joins the fight, and a Rocket Launcher makes short work of it. Grizzbolt then gains Grass moves too, Spine Vine and Seed Mine, which have a chance of leaving you ivy-covered, and a Grappling Gun helps you dodge while you are.

quoted: Grizzbolt's Lightning Claw attack can be hard to dodge.
try to rely on your Shield to tank the damage.
Hiding behind & circling around the pillars allows you to avoid most of Grizzbolt's attacks.
Calling back your Pal just as Grizzbolt is about to damage it, then throwing it back out, is a good way to avoid it getting damaged and make it attack faster.
Zoe and Grizzbolt will also spawn alongside a level 55 Syndicate Crusher.
A Rocket Launcher can be used to easily deal with the Crusher.
Grizzbolt will now have access to Grass-element attacks such as Spine Vine and Seed Mine
these attacks have a chance to leave you ivy-covered
If you find yourself ivy-covered, use a Grappling Gun to dodge attacks.

lines.line: Summary: She leads the Free Pal Alliance and is fought with her partner Lyleen in the Tower on the Crescent Moon Shore. She is the second Faction Leader you are expected to fight, and in hard mode she is level 74.

quoted: She is the leader of the Free Pal Alliance and her partner Pal is Lyleen, with her Tower being located in the Crescent Moon Shore.
being the second faction leader the player is expected to fight.
Boss level: 74

lines.line: Weak points: Lyleen is a Grass Pal that mostly uses Grass moves, so Fire Pals are the best answer, but it also has Water moves, such as Acid Rain and Bubble Blast, to counter them, so be careful. Vanwyrm resists its Grass attacks. Wixen's Partner Skill strengthens your attacks and gives them Fire damage for as long as it is out. The Fire Arrow Crossbow does extra damage to Lyleen and can burn it.

quoted: As Lyleen is a Grass-element Pal and uses mostly Grass-element attacks, Fire-element Pals are recommended when fighting it.
Lyleen also comes with Water-element attacks like Acid Rain and Bubble Blast for dealing with Fire Pals, so caution is recommended when using them.
Vanwyrm is a good choice as it resists Lyleen's Grass-element attacks
Wixen is also a good choice as its Partner Skill increases the player's Attack power and applies Fire-element damage to the player's attacks while Wixen is active.
The Fire Arrow Crossbow is also a good choice due to it dealing increased damage against Lyleen and having the ability to burn it.

lines.line: Looks like: Lily is barefoot, with short white hair marked by pale green streaks. Her green toga has gold lines on it, and on her forehead is a crown like a branch whose left side juts upward, set with rubies that stand for fruit.

quoted: has short white hair with light green streaks.
She wears a green toga with golden lines.
On her forehead, she has a crown that resembles a branch with the left side protruding upwards, adorned with rubies that are meant to be fruits.

lines.line: Tips: Stay back when Lyleen uses Poison Fog, or you will be poisoned, and be ready for it to heal itself, which makes it tricky to finish off. In hard mode two level 55 Free Pal Alliance Devouts with Crossbows join the fight; kill them first, or their electric arrows will keep troubling you all through the battle. Lyleen then uses Water attacks more than Grass, so an Electric Pal that resists Water can help, and Flame Funnel is a top choice against it.

quoted: Try to keep your distance so you don't get poisoned when Lyleen uses Poison Fog.
Lyleen is able to heal itself, which can prove difficult to deal with.
Lily and Lyleen will also spawn alongside a pair of level 55 Free Pal Alliance Devouts armed with Crossbows.
Take the Devouts out first so their electric arrows won't hamper you throughout the rest of the fight.
Lyleen will now use Water-element attacks more than Grass-element attacks
bringing an Electric Pal to resist Lyleen's Water attacks could prove useful.
Flame Funnel is one of the best attacks to use against Lyleen.

lines.line: Summary: He leads the Brothers of the Eternal Pyre and is fought with his partner Orserk in the Tower at the top of Mount Obsidian. He is the third Faction Leader you are expected to fight, at level 30 in normal mode and level 76 in hard mode. The arena has electrified grids that can be turned on at will to catch players off guard.

quoted: He is the leader of the Brothers of the Eternal Pyre and his partner Pal is Orserk, with his Tower being located on Mount Obsidian.
being the third faction leader the player is expected to fight.
|| Axel and Orserk || 30 || 76
Axel and Orserk's battlefield has electrified grids which can be activated at will to electrify unsuspecting players

lines.line: Weak points: Orserk is part Dragon and part Electric and attacks with both, so Ice and Ground Pals are the best answer. Reptyro Cryst resists everything Orserk throws and has high Defense, so it can soak up hits. Anubis is a strong attacker that gives your attacks Ground damage while it is out. Wumpo's Snow Bowling works very well against Orserk. In hard mode Orserk still has no Fire attacks, so Ice Pals stay effective.

quoted: As Orserk is a Dragon / Electric-element Pal and uses Dragon and Electric-element attacks, Ice and Ground-element Pals are recommended when fighting it.
Reptyro Cryst is a very good choice as it resists all of Orserk's attacks and has high Defense, making it an effective tank.
Anubis is also a good choice as it is a very strong attacker and applies Ground-element damage to the player's attacks while active.
Wumpo is also a good choice as its Snow Bowling attack is very effective against Orserk.
it doesn't have any Fire-element attacks, meaning Ice Pals are still very effective against it.

lines.line: Looks like: Axel is young and athletically built. His purple hair is tipped in yellow, shaped like lightning bolts, and his black beanie carries zigzags in yellow and purple.

quoted: Axel is a young man with an athletic build.
His hair is purple with yellow tips that resemble lightning bolts.
sports a black beanie with yellow and purple zigzag patterns on it

lines.line: Tips: Orserk's Kerauno attack hurts a lot, so avoid it where you can. In hard mode a level 55 Mossanda Lux and a level 55 Relaxaurus Lux join the fight; they are not tough, and area attacks clear them quickly. Orserk also gains Grass attacks such as Crosswind and Solar Blast to deal with Ground Pals. Frostallion and Gildane are good hard mode picks, since riding them adds Ice or Ground damage to your attacks.

quoted: Orserk's Kerauno attack can deal heavy damage. Try to dodge it whenever possible.
Axel and Orserk will now spawn alongside a Mossanda Lux and a Relaxaurus Lux, with both being level 55.
they aren't very strong and can easily be taken out with AOE attacks.
Orserk now comes with Grass-element attacks like Crosswind and Solar Blast for dealing with Ground-element Pals.
Frostallion is a good choice due to its high stats and ability to increase the player's Attack power and apply Ice-element damage to the player's attacks while mounted.
Gildane is also a good choice as it increases the player's Attack power and applies Ground-element damage to the player's attacks while mounted.

lines.line: Summary: He commands the Palpagos Islands Defense Force and fights alongside his partner Faleris in the Tower in the Desiccated Dunes. He is the fourth Faction Leader you are expected to fight, at level 40 in normal mode and level 78 in hard mode, and the first whose partner can fly.

quoted: He is the leader of the Palpagos Islands Defense Force and his partner Pal is Faleris, with his Tower being located in the Desiccated Dunes.
being the fourth faction leader the player is expected to fight.
Marcus is the first faction leader to possess a Pal capable of flight.
|| Marcus and Faleris || 40 || 78

lines.line: Weak points: Faleris is a Fire Pal that mostly uses Fire moves, so Water Pals are the best answer, but it has a few Electric moves to counter them, so be careful. Azurobe gives your attacks Water damage while you ride it but is slow on land, so it tends to get hit; Suzaku Aqua strengthens its own Water attacks while mounted; Jormuntide is a good pick too, though its size makes it hard to dodge with. Curtain Splash and Hydro Slicer rank among the strongest moves to use on Faleris.

quoted: As Faleris is a Fire-element Pal and uses mostly Fire-element attacks, Water-element Pals are recommended when fighting it.
Faleris has some Electric-element attacks for dealing with Water Pals, so caution is recommended when using them.
Azurobe is a good choice as it increases the player's attack power and applies water element damage to the player's attacks while mounted.
Azurobe isn't very fast on land, meaning it'll probably get hit more than intended.
Suzaku Aqua is also a good choice as it boosts the power of its Water-element attacks while mounted.
Jormuntide is also a good choice, though its large size means that it has a hard time dodging.
Curtain Splash and Hydro Slicer are two of the best attacks to use on Faleris.

lines.line: Looks like: Marcus is a tall man with a sturdy frame and a two-tone beard, brown streaked with black. His coat is a long, dark military one, with fur around the collar and a pair of stripes on each sleeve.

quoted: Marcus is a tall, well-built man
He has a two-toned beard that is brown with black streaks.
his long, dark military coat with a fur collar. There are two stripes on the sleeves of the coat.

lines.line: Tips: The Pump-action Shotgun, the Assault Rifle and the Semi-Auto Shotgun usually work best at this level. In hard mode he arrives with a team of level 55 PIDF Infantry and PIDF Elites, who are weak enough that area attacks clear them easily, and Selyne helps because its Partner Skill makes Holy Burst hit harder.

quoted: The Pump-action Shotgun, Assault Rifle, and Semi-Auto Shotgun are typically the best weapon options for this fight at this level.
Marcus and Faleris will also spawn alongside a team of PIDF Infantry and PIDF Elites, with all of them being level 55.
they aren't very strong and can be easily taken out with AOE attacks.
Selyne is a good choice as its Partner Skill boosts the power of Holy Burst, which can deal high damage.

lines.line: Summary: He runs the PAL Genetic Research Unit and is fought together with his partner Shadowbeak in the Tower in the Astral Mountains. He is level 50 in normal mode and level 80 in hard mode.

quoted: He is the leader of the PAL Genetic Research Unit and his partner Pal is Shadowbeak, with his Tower being located in the Astral Mountains.
|| Victor and Shadowbeak || 50 || 80

lines.line: Weak points: Shadowbeak is a Dark Pal that mostly uses Dark moves, so Dragon Pals are the best answer, though it has some Ice moves to counter them. Jormuntide Ignis hits hard and takes only normal damage from those Ice moves, but it is big and hard to dodge with. Chillet gives your attacks Dragon damage while you ride it. Vanwyrm Cryst shrugs off every attack Shadowbeak has apart from Flame Funnel.

quoted: As Shadowbeak is a Dark-element Pal and uses mostly Dark-element attacks, Dragon-element Pals are recommended when fighting it.
Shadowbeak also has some Ice-element attacks for dealing with Dragon Pals, so caution is recommended when using them.
Jormuntide Ignis is a good choice as it is a very strong attacker and only takes normal damage from Shadowbeak's Ice attacks, though its large size means that it has a hard time dodging.
Chillet is also a good choice as it increases the player's Attack power and applies Dragon-element damage to the player's attacks while mounted.
Vanwyrm Cryst is also a good choice as it resists all of Shadowbeak's attacks (except for Flame Funnel)

lines.line: Looks like: Victor is a thin, pale man whose eyes are hidden behind a black blindfold. His wavy hair is black and white, and his long black coat is purple on the inside.

quoted: Victor is a pale, thin man with wavy black-and-white hair.
He wears a long black coat with a purple interior
a black blindfold over his eyes.

lines.line: Tips: The Assault Rifle and Rocket Launcher usually work best at this level. In hard mode, when he and Shadowbeak drop to roughly 30 percent health, a clone of the pair appears, as strong as the originals and with the same attacks. You can tell the real ones because their health bar sits along the screen's upper edge, while the clone's hovers over its head; defeating the real pair removes the clone too, so go for them. Vampiric on your Pals together with area attacks such as Holy Burst and Air Blade heals you a lot, since the attacks should land on both.

quoted: The Assault Rifle and Rocket Launcher are typically the best weapon options for this fight at this level.
will now summon a clone of themselves when they reach approximately 30% health.

Defeating the real Victor and Shadowbeak will also kill the clone.
Having Vampiric on your Pals and using AOE attacks like Holy Burst and Air Blade is very effective as they will likely hit both the real Shadowbeak and the clone, resulting in lots of healing.

lines.line: Summary: A Dark Pal that does not live anywhere in the world: you summon it as a Raid Boss at a Summoning Altar with Bellanoir's Slab. Its health is 294,000, and it is the one Raid Boss with no Ultra form.

is a Dark-element Pal.

Bellanoir can be summoned as a Raid Boss in a Summoning Altar using a Bellanoir's Slab.

lines.line: Weak points: Bellanoir attacks with Dark moves, so Dragon Pals are the best answer. Astegon takes very little damage from them, which makes it a solid tank; Orserk, Jormuntide and Jormuntide Ignis also resist its attacks and hit hard. Chillet gives your attacks Dragon damage while you ride it. For weapons, the usual choices are the Assault Rifle and Rocket Launcher.

quoted: As Bellanoir is a Dark-element Pal and uses Dark-element attacks, Dragon-element Pals are recommended when fighting it.
Astegon is a very good choice as it massively resists Bellanoir's attacks, making it an effective tank.
Orserk, Jormuntide, and Jormuntide Ignis are also good choices as they are strong attackers and resist Bellanoir's attacks.
Chillet is also a good choice as it boosts the player's Attack power and applies Dragon-element damage to the player's attacks while mounted.
The Assault Rifle and Rocket Launcher are typically the best weapon options for this fight around this level.

lines.line: Looks like: Tall and partly human in shape, its body looks like a black gown in motion. Red marks like eyes circle the waist, large blue-purple flames burn where the legs should be, and an antler-shaped growth juts from the left of the forehead.

quoted: Bellanoir is a tall, semi-humanoid Pal whose body resembles a flowing black dress with a ring of red eye-like patterns along the waist and large, blueish-purple flames visible beneath the dress in place of legs.
Bellanoir also has an antler-like protrusion coming out of the left side of its forehead

lines.line: Tips: Bellanoir is rated at about level 30 to 35, yet it is strong enough that you should reach about level 40 to 45 before trying it. Its Nightmare Ray hurts badly, so avoid it where you can. Choose the Raid Area rather than your base, since a Raid Boss can do widespread damage to a base, and you get ten minutes to win before it despawns and the raid fails.

quoted: Despite being only around level 30, Bellanoir is powerful to the point where you should probably wait until reaching around level 40-45 before even attempting to fight it.
Bellanoir's Nightmare Ray attack deals heavy damage. Try to dodge it whenever possible.
It is generally recommended to pick the Raid Area as Raid Bosses are capable of causing mass damage to bases

lines.line: Summary: Raid Bosses are the game's toughest fights: powerful Pals you summon yourself at a Summoning Altar, with ten minutes to win. They are Bellanoir, Bellanoir Libero, Blazamut Ryu, Xenolord, Hartalis and Moon Lord. All but Bellanoir also come in a stronger Ultra or Master version at level 80.

Raid Bosses currently represent the game's ultimate challenge.

lines.line: Tips: The Summoning Altar is unlocked at 33 in the Ancient Technology list, for 3 points. It costs 100 Stone and 20 Paldium Fragment and can only be built inside a Pal Base. Each boss needs its own slab: you put one together at most Handiwork stations from fragments you find in Treasure Chests or earn on Expeditions. Once the boss is summoned you pick between your own base and the Raid Area, and only one Raid Boss can be out at a time. If the ten minutes run out, the boss leaves and the raid is lost, and the damage it already did to your structures is not undone. A win drops Ancient Civilization Parts, Ancient Civilization Cores and Training Crystals, plus a Pal Egg that hatches into the boss, ordinary or Alpha; the Moon Lord drops no egg.

Cost: 3 points

lines.line: Summary: Extremely strong versions of ordinary Pals that always attack on sight and cannot be captured. A kill pays out 25 times the experience of the ordinary version. They are rare: now and then one spawns at random in place of a regular Pal instead of at a fixed spot, and only certain species can appear this way.

quoted: Predator Pals are extremely strong Pals with unique Active Skills and drops.
Regardless of their species, Predator Pals always attack on sight.
They cannot be captured
When defeated, they give 25 times the amount of XP their normal variants would give
Predator Pals have a low chance of randomly spawning in place of regular Pals rather than spawning in fixed locations. Only certain species of Pals can spawn as Predator Pals.

lines.line: Looks like: Larger than the ordinary Pal, with eyes that shine red and a red aura around its body.

quoted: Predator Pals are similar to Alpha Pals in that they are both larger and stronger than regular Pals, though Predator Pals have glowing red eyes and a red aura that surrounds them.

lines.line: Tips: They use three Neutral-element skills. Predator Surge charges up, then explodes around the user; Predator Blast builds up power and releases a sustained beam; Predator Mark shoots three fast beams in a row. They are missing from the world map, but you can hear a low hum when one is close. Defeating one drops Predator Cores and Giant Pal Souls, but no Ancient Civilization Parts, and a first kill gives neither Ancient Technology Points nor Pal Bounty Tokens. Species that can appear include Direhowl at level 10 and Gildra at level 46.

quoted: Predator Surge: Charges up energy and then lets off a huge explosion around itself.
Predator Blast: Charges up and fires a powerful sustained beam at the target
Predator Mark: Fires three high-velocity beams at the target one after the other
They do not appear on the world map
They emit a low pitched humming sound when nearby
Predator Pals will also drop Predator Cores and Giant Pal Souls when defeated.
They do not drop Ancient Technology Points or Pal Bounty Tokens when defeated for the first time
They do not drop Ancient Civilization Parts or valuable items when defeated
|| Direhowl || 10 || 1

lines.line: Summary: Named human enemies that act as world bosses at fixed spots on the map, each marked with an icon. They attack on sight, sometimes with a partner Pal, and come back after a set time once beaten.

quoted: Bounty Targets are named Human enemies that serve as world bosses.
with their locations marked with a icon on the map.
They are all aggressive and will attack the player on sight.
will sometimes have their own Pals summoned to fight by their side.
When defeated, Bounty Targets will respawn after a set period of time.

lines.line: Looks like: Larger than ordinary human characters, with glowing red eyes and a purple aura around them.

quoted: but are a good deal larger, have glowing red eyes, and are surrounded by a purple aura

lines.line: Tips: The higher a target's level, the more it asks of you: better equipment, stronger Pals, or just more planning. Every target drops Successful Bounty Tokens, and higher-level ones drop more; a Vigilante Bounty Officer swaps them for items. The first time you beat a target you also earn Ancient Technology Points. Ask a Bounty Intel Dealer for details on the targets in an area. Targets range from Scoot at level 10 to Ram at level 59, and some bring a partner Pal, such as Crash with a Direhowl.

quoted: Higher-level Bounty Targets generally pose greater challenges and require stronger equipment, higher-level Pals, or more preparation to defeat.
they will always drop varying amounts of Successful Bounty Tokens when defeated, which can be turned in to a Vigilante Bounty Officer in exchange for items.
Higher-level Bounty Targets will drop more tokens than lower-level ones.
Bounty Targets also give Ancient Technology Points when defeated for the first time.
Players can also speak to a Bounty Intel Dealer to get more information about Bounty Targets in a given area.
|| Scoot || 10
|| Crash || 15 || Insurance Fraud || Direhowl

lines.line: Summary: A consumable that teaches a Pal one Active Skill: you pick the fruit in your inventory and choose a Pal from your party.

quoted: Skill Fruits are consumable items
by selecting the Skill Fruit in the inventory, the Active Skill can be taught to any Pal in your party.

lines.line: Uses: Each fruit is tied to one skill, and the Pal's element need not match it, so Fire Pals can be taught Water moves. Any fruit can go to any Pal, whatever its element, and it can be used on caught humans too. Each skill fruit has a rarity from Uncommon to Epic and a power figure; Air Cannon is Uncommon with power 40, and Holy Burst is Epic with power 700.

quoted: Each Skill Fruit is associated with an Active Skill
Skill Fruits do not have to be given to Pals with the same typing, so a Fire Pal can learn a Water move, or vice versa.
Any Skill Fruit can be used on any Pal, regardless of element, as well as caught Humans.
|| Skill Fruit: Air Cannon || Uncommon || 2 || 40
|| Skill Fruit: Holy Burst || Epic || 30 || 700

lines.line: Tips: Most grow on blue-tinted trees around the islands. Treasure Chests in Dungeons can hold them as well, and on rare occasions one spawns on the ground. Life Fruit, Power Fruit and Stout Fruit form a separate group of Legendary fruits, each adding 10 to a Pal's HP, Attack or Defense Potential.

quoted: Skill Fruits are primarily located hanging from blue-tinted trees found around the Palpagos Islands.
They can also be looted from Treasure Chests in Dungeons, and very rarely may spawn on the ground.
|| Life Fruit || Legendary || +10 HP Potential
|| Power Fruit || Legendary || +10 Attack Potential
|| Stout Fruit || Legendary || +10 Defense Potential

lines.line: Summary: A key item you get the first time you defeat or catch an overworld Alpha Pal. Each one is tied to an element and gives your Pals a lasting boost to the Active Skills of its element.

quoted: A Pal Bounty Token is a type of key item obtained by defeating Alpha Pals.
Each Alpha Pal drops one Pal Bounty Token the first time it is defeated or captured.
Each Pal Bounty Token corresponds to a specific elemental damage type, such as Fire, Ice, or Dragon, and increases the damage dealt by a Pal's Active Skills of that element.

lines.line: Uses: The effect applies by itself and for good, with nothing to equip, and it only boosts Pal Active Skills, not your own weapons. Tokens come in small, medium and large grades worth +1%, +2% and +3%, and same-element tokens add together. Some high-level Alpha Pal areas stay closed until you hold certain tokens.

quoted: Once obtained, their effects are applied automatically and permanently, without needing to be equipped or activated.
These bonuses apply only to Pal Active Skills and do not affect player weapon damage.
|| Small || +1%
|| Medium || +2%
|| Large || +3%
Multiple Pal Bounty Tokens of the same element stack additively
Some Alpha Pal areas cannot be entered until the player has collected specific Pal Bounty Tokens.

lines.line: Tips: It is not the Successful Bounty Token, which comes from human Bounty Targets and is traded to a Vigilante Officer. You find these in the Key Items part of your inventory, and they cannot be spent, traded, sold or consumed. The same Alpha gives no further token after the first time.

quoted: Pal Bounty Tokens are not a currency and are unrelated to Successful Bounty Tokens, which are earned from human fugitives and traded with Vigilante Officers.
Pal Bounty Tokens are stored in the Key Items section of the inventory.
Pal Bounty Tokens cannot be consumed, spent, traded, or sold.
After this initial acquisition, the same Alpha Pal will not grant additional Pal Bounty Tokens through normal defeats.

lines.line: Summary: A small green statue of a Pal, scattered across the islands, that you hand in at a Statue of Power to raise your capture power and make Pals easier to catch.

quoted: Lifmunk Effigies are small green statues of the Pal Lifmunk that are scattered throughout the Palpagos Islands.
They are used to increase the player's Capture Power at a Statue of Power, making it easier to capture Pals.

lines.line: Uses: Put up a Statue of Power yourself, or come across one in the wild, interact with it, and spend effigies on the next capture power level. Each level costs more effigies than the one before. The bonus is worth the most near the end of the game, where plenty of high-level Pals can slip out of nearly every sphere. The Statue of Power unlocks at level 9 for 2 technology points.

quoted: players must either build a Statue of Power or find one out in the wild.
with the number of effigies required increasing with every level.
This bonus comes in especially handy in the late game where many high-level Pals can easily break out of most Spheres.
The amount of effigies needed for every enhancement increases with level.
Required Level 9 Point Cost 2

lines.line: Tips: They are easy to spot after dark from a long way off, thanks to their bright green glow. Search beyond the obvious spots: behind waterfalls, on top of rocky peaks and inside ruins are all worth checking, and a few sit hidden in crevices at ground level.

quoted: Because of their bright green glow, Lifmunk Effigies are very easy to spot at night, even from far away.
Don't limit your search to obvious spots. Check behind waterfalls, atop rocky peaks, and even within ruins.
They can also be found on ground levels, sometimes hidden within crevices.

lines.line: Summary: A Rare crafting material that many Ancient Technology items and structures need, which merchants do not sell. It comes from Alpha and Lucky Pals and from certain Expeditions.

quoted: Ancient Civilization Parts are a material in Palworld.
Material Rare
Ancient Civilization Parts cannot be purchased from any merchants.
Ancient Civilization Parts are obtained by defeating, capturing, or butchering Alpha or Lucky Pals as well as completing certain Expeditions.

lines.line: Uses: Many Ancient Technology items and structures need it. So do items made from Uncommon or better Schematics, and the Pal Labor Research Laboratory also takes it for research.

quoted: They are used to craft many items and structures that are unlocked from Ancient Technology, craft items from uncommon or higher tier Schematics, and perform research at the Pal Labor Research Laboratory.

lines.line: Tips: Anubis and Bastigor always drop 4 to 6 of it, and Bellanoir always drops 1 to 3. One part weighs 1 and sells for 100.

quoted: Anubis ×4–6 • 100%
Bastigor ×4–6 • 100%
Bellanoir ×1–3 • 100%
Weight 1 Sell Price 100

lines.line: Summary: A special currency you get from defeating Bounty Targets, with the tougher targets giving more tokens.

quoted: Successful Bounty Tokens are a special currency obtained by defeating Bounty Targets.
The stronger the bounty, the more Successful Bounty Tokens the player will obtain by defeating them.

lines.line: Uses: Hand them to a Vigilante Bounty Officer to buy items such as Ancient Pal Manuscripts, High Grade Technical Manuals and Pal Reversers.

quoted: They can be traded in to a Vigilante Bounty Officer to purchase items like Ancient Pal Manuscripts, High Grade Technical Manuals, Pal Reversers, and more.

lines.line: Tips: No merchant sells them, so they only come from Bounty Targets. If you capture a target it still drops tokens, and butchering it afterwards drops them a second time, so you get twice as many. It is not the same as the Pal Bounty Token, which comes from Alpha Pals.

quoted: Successful Bounty Token cannot be purchased from any merchants.
Bounty Targets can be captured and will drop their bounty tokens both after being caught and when they are butchered, effectively doubling their yield.
Pal Bounty Tokens are not a currency and are unrelated to Successful Bounty Tokens
